profile.owner: GorillaDesk LLC, privately held and founder-led (founder and CEO Chris Moreschi per CB Insights). Craft lists a Boca Raton, Florida headquarters and 2012 founding. No parent company or outside investor found.
profile.target_customers: Small owner-operator and small-team home service businesses (pest, mosquito, termite, wildlife, lawn, pool, cleaning and 25+ other trades). Capterra reviewers mostly report 2-10 employees, but the pest page showcases pest and wildlife firms with 13 to 27 technicians, including Midwest companies; the Growth tier adds multi-branch for growing firms. Not pest-only.
profile.pricing: Priced per route (schedule) per month, each plan including 1 route: Basic $49, Pro $99, Growth $149. Extra routes cost $30 to $100 each depending on tier. Unlimited office users. SMS add-on $5/mo plus credits ($50 per 1,000). VoIP $65 to $275/mo. AI agents $1.00 to $1.75 per completed conversation. MailStream email $5 per 1,000. Yearly billing gives one month free. No setup fee, no contract, free data migration.
profile.deployment: Cloud (web app at app.gorilladesk.com) plus native iOS and Android apps. No on-premise or desktop install.
profile.mobile_app: GorillaDesk (iOS and Android, phone and tablet, one app for office and technicians; rated 4.4 from 62 ratings on the US App Store and about 4.2 from 406 ratings on Google Play per a third-party tracker, October 2026); DoorMamba (free door-to-door sales app built by GorillaDesk).
integrations: Stripe (cards, ACH, subscriptions, Tap to Pay)
Square (cards, card hardware, Tap to Pay)
GorillaDesk open API and MCP server
Google Calendar and Apple Calendar sync
strengths: Low, transparent per-route pricing with unlimited office users, no contracts, no setup fee and free data migration.
Strong ease of use and support reputation (Capterra 4.8 from 278 reviews, ease of use and support both 4.8).
Useful pest basics: material records with EPA numbers, barcode device tracking with monthly trend reports, Sentricon InPulse export, NPMA-33 forms.
Fast release cadence and broad AI push: AI receptionist, AI data analyst, AI routing, AI website builder and an MCP server in 2026.
Wide horizontal reach (29+ trades) with door-to-door app, VoIP, email campaigns and website builder under one login.
weaknesses: No built-in accounting: relies on one-way QuickBooks Online sync (Pro plan) with no general ledger or documented deferred revenue handling.
Many core features are gated to Pro or Growth, and SMS, VoIP, AI conversations and MailStream are billed separately, so costs climb.
Reviewers call reporting basic: no report builder, custom reports cannot be saved, and no automatic sales tax by address.
Shallow compliance depth: no documented applicator license tracking, label or SDS storage, stock-level inventory, or state-specific report formats.
Offline mode is limited to the current week, and job and invoice details cannot be edited offline; some reviewers report bugs after the V3 release.

features.notes: Customizable staged sales pipeline with close dates and pipeline reporting is Growth plan only; inbound leads arrive via web form, booking and AI receptionist.
Revenue by Source and Sales Forecast by Source reports exist; no campaign attribution or close rate by source documented.
Custom quotes with templates and automated estimate reminders; tiered estimate packages and dynamic add-on suggestions require the Growth plan.
Document library and e-signature on estimates, invoices and agreements are Pro plan features; customers sign from any device or the portal.
DoorMamba, a free GorillaDesk-built app, offers territory drawing, door pins, knock logs and rep GPS; leads sync into GorillaDesk. Sales Rabbit also listed.
Pro plan add-on: production and sold-by commissions per line item, percent or flat, with reports; no cancellation holds or chargebacks documented.
MailStream (Pro plan, pay per send, limited release) runs bulk and drip email or SMS campaigns; estimate reminders automate quote follow-up.
Terminate Service status requires a cancellation reason and feeds churn counts; no save attempts or retention workflow documented.
Customers can hold many service locations with bill-to and service-to details; statements combine invoices across locations. MDU unit tracking on Pro.
VoIP add-on ($65 to $275 per month) logs and records calls on the customer profile, with auto attendant and autodialer; caller ID pop undocumented.
Recurring jobs support daily, weekly, monthly, annual or custom intervals (such as every 14 days), with end dates, job counts and month exclusions.
Service plan templates sequence a set of visits, and recurrence can stop after N jobs or skip months; no dedicated round or due-window model.
Central line items and service templates; tiered estimate packages and map area measurement are Growth only; no size-based price matrix documented.
Pro plan global override raises all line item rates by percent or fixed amount and updates draft invoices; effect on recurring invoices unclear.
No documented contract term, auto-renewal or early cancellation fee fields; mosquito page only mentions automatic renewal notices for service plans.
No termite warranty or warranty renewal tracking feature found in feature pages or help center.
Vendor suggests logging resprays with tags or notes; no dedicated re-service tracking or callback cost capture documented.
Next recurring visit is generated when the current one is completed or canceled, with future visits shown as recurrence tiles; no due windows.
Drag and drop calendar plus map view of jobs and customers, with map batch select and an unscheduled job work pool.
Route optimizer on all plans (Basic capped at 25 stops); Pro adds real drive times, Growth adds Job Magnet; Mantis AI routing in beta.

Mantis AI Routing (beta, Growth plan, preview only with the live version coming soon) matches service type to technician skills from a Skills Manager; licenses and certifications are not used, and whether a mismatch blocks assignment is not stated.
Online booking widget for customers and leads is a Pro plan add-on with slot selection and website embed; self-service rescheduling not documented.
Live GPS tracking and location history for technician devices is a Pro plan feature; on-my-way texts can share live location.
Batch move, batch reassign and calendar multi-select tools shift many jobs at once, plus batch-sent confirmations and reminders.
GorillaDesk app for iOS and Android phones and tablets (App Store 4.4 from 62 ratings; Google Play about 4.2 from 406 per a third-party tracker), with Spanish support, dark mode and offline mode.

Offline mode covers only the current week once loaded (article dated Dec 2024); techs can change status, add check-in and check-out times, notes and materials, but job and invoice details are read-only, and offline photos, signatures and payments are not documented.
Techs record materials with EPA number, quantity, unit, dilution, target pest, area, method and device; presets speed entry on Pro and Growth.
Customer signatures, note attachments and images on paperwork are captured in the app; the Sketch drawing tool is Pro only.
Barcode scanning by phone camera or 1D/2D Bluetooth scanner is part of Pro plan device tracking; QR codes not supported.
Card payments in the app through Stripe or Square, including Tap to Pay on the phone and Square card hardware; mobile tipping added May 2026 (Stripe only).
Time Clocking on the Pro plan records clock in and out with hourly rates and day, week or month summaries for payroll.
No documented truck stock or on-device inventory; material usage documentation shows no stock deduction.
Per-visit material records with EPA number, rate, target pest, area and method appear on invoices; weather data is labeled on PDFs (April 2025 change log); applicator license fields not documented.
Materials and EPA master list stores registration numbers; storing label or SDS documents per product is not documented.
No applicator license number, category or expiry tracking found in the help center or feature pages.
Material Use report filters by date, county or job and exports to CSV or Excel; vendor claims state logs but names no state formats.
Completion triggers auto-send invoices or work orders listing materials applied; no dedicated pre-application notice or registry notification documented.
No restricted-use pesticide flags or applicator restrictions found in material usage documentation.
Material usage tracking is marketed as inventory tracking, but stock levels, warehouses, purchasing and transfers are not documented.
Chemical tracking pages refer to generic state requirements and name no state formats or rules.
Pro plan device tracking for traps, glue boards, bait stations and Sentricon devices tied to locations, with barcodes and activity levels.
Device pins shown on a geographic map of the job site (Pro); floor plans not documented, though Sketch accepts background images.
Device Trend Report power-up (Pro) tracks monthly device activity and can appear on invoices or work orders sent to customers.
No AIB, SQF, BRC or other food safety audit reporting found on device tracking pages.
Customer portal (Pro) shows invoice, estimate and document history including device and material data; labels, SDS and site maps not documented.
No customer pest sighting log or corrective action tracking found.

Net 30/60/90 payment terms (March 2025), PO numbers that repeat on recurring invoices with PO search (December 2025), and statements spanning multiple locations; a single consolidated invoice across sites is not documented.
Pro plan items: NPMA-33 and NPMA-99 forms, Sketch graphing with grid, and Sentricon device tracking with InPulse export file.
Wildlife control is listed as an industry, but no multi-visit trapping, exclusion or repair workflow is documented.
Bed bug agreement template in the document library; no multi-visit bed bug workflow or customer prep checklist documented.
Mosquito page shows 14, 21 or 30 day intervals, whole-season scheduling, pre-season reminders and renewal notices; tick add-ons via estimate packages.
No native processor; card and ACH run through Stripe or Square integrations at no extra GorillaDesk fee; Stripe ACH instant verification added 2026.
Cards stored via Stripe or Square; invoices can auto-charge the card on file on schedule; Pro adds Stripe and Square subscription billing.
Invoice frequency can differ from service frequency (monthly service billed quarterly, quarterly billed annually), alongside per-visit invoicing on completion.
Unlimited manually set tax rates with a tax liability report; no automatic rate by service address, and reviewers ask for ZIP-based tax.
Automated late payment reminders and automatic late fees via payment terms; payment retries and service holds not documented.
Statements combine invoices across locations with open item, transaction and forward balance views, emailable with an online pay link.
Terminating service voids the linked invoice; no automatic proration or cancellation balance documented.
Help center positions QuickBooks as the full financial system; GorillaDesk handles scheduling, invoicing and payment tracking only.
Pro plan one-way sync of customers, invoices, payments, credits and US taxes to QuickBooks Online; QuickBooks Desktop not documented.
Integrations library lists only QuickBooks Online for accounting; no Xero, Sage or NetSuite connector (Zapier workaround possible).
No deferred revenue feature documented; accrual guidance recognizes income at invoice date and there is no general ledger.
No labor and material cost per job or job margin reporting found in the reports list.
Production commission and time clock reports (Pro) export to CSV or Excel; no payroll provider integration documented.
Pro plan portal: pay balances or invoices, manage card on file, view history, rate service; booking needs the Online Booking add-on.

Automated appointment confirmations, reminders and on-my-way messages with optional live location; texting requires the paid SMS add-on ($5 a month plus credits), so it is scored Add-on like Pocomos and PestPac.
Two-way texting requires the SMS add-on: $5 per month for a local number plus prepaid credits from $50 per 1,000 messages.
Review Engine on the Pro plan turns completed jobs into review requests and collects likely-to-refer and service ratings.
Invoices and work orders carry a materials applied table and device summaries; completion triggers can email or text them automatically.
20+ built-in reports including sales, payments, sales tax, revenue by client or service, AR aging with point-in-time view, plus a dashboard.
Dashboard counts terminated jobs and reports list customers without active jobs; no retention rates by route, technician or service.
Revenue by Staff, time clocking and commission reports exist; no stops per hour, time on site or re-service rate reports documented.
No report builder; reports export to CSV or Excel, Kong AI answers data questions, and the API and MCP server expose data.
Multi-branch management with linked accounts and cross-branch user access is a Growth plan feature.
Two roles (Admin, Technician) with per-user permission toggles such as deleting jobs, card access, exports and branch management.
Open API and Zapier are Pro plan features; API endpoints expanded in 2026 and an MCP server launched August 2026.
Free migration by Customer Success covering contacts, addresses, notes and starting balances; full service and billing history not imported.
AI agents: Maya receptionist, Kong data analyst, Mantis routing (beta), Atrax website builder, plus writing assistant; billed $1.00 to $1.75 per conversation.
Atrax AI website builder with custom domains, an embeddable contact form that creates leads, and an online booking widget.
SnailMail mails invoices and paperwork and Atrax builds websites; no call tracking numbers, marketing direct mail or SEO service documented.

extra_features.notes: Customers add tips when paying; launched May 2026 with a per-transaction connect fee, Square not yet supported.
Configurable card surcharge from 0.01% to 3%, removed from ACH and debit, auto-disabled in states that ban surcharges.
Generates the report file Corteva's InPulse site requires for Certified Sentricon Specialist billing submissions.
Draws and measures property area on a map for quoting, with saved location profiles; web and mobile, Growth plan.

extra_features.feature: Job Magnet and Best Available Time
extra_features.notes: Groups nearby jobs and suggests the best open slot for a new job based on drive time; Growth plan.
Holding area for unscheduled jobs that dispatchers can filter and drag onto schedules.
Launched August 2026; lets supported AI assistants connect to live GorillaDesk account data.
Team email inbox synced and linked to customer and job records; Pro plan.

extra_features.feature: Document library with free custom builds
extra_features.notes: 150+ templates (NPMA-33, NPMA-99, service agreements); vendor builds custom or state-required forms free on Pro.
Likely-to-refer and service ratings collected after jobs, with Likely Rating and Service Rating reports.
Collect a deposit when a customer accepts an estimate.
Internal task system tied to customer records for office follow-ups.
